name: troparcel
description: Collaboration for Tropy: share notes, tags, metadata, selections, transcriptions and lists with your team, through a Troparcel server or a shared folder. Photos stay on each computer.
author: Micah

scripts.pack: node esbuild.config.mjs && zip -r troparcel.zip package.json index.js icon.svg

options.label: Connection — server address or shared folder
options.hint: Paste the connection string your coordinator gave you, a ws:// server address, or the path of a folder you all sync (Nextcloud, Dropbox, Syncthing). Everyone in a group uses the same one.

options.label: Your name — shown on what you contribute
options.hint: Collaborators see this name as an @tag on items you contributed to. Use a different name from everyone else in the group.

options.label: Mode — auto, review, push or pull
options.hint: auto: share and receive continuously. review: share continuously, receive when you choose File > Import > Troparcel. push: share only. pull: receive only, when you import.

options.label: Share deletions
options.hint: When on, a note you delete is struck through for everyone else (only its author can retract it), and a tag or list membership you remove is removed for them.

options.label: Share lists
options.hint: When on, your list tree and which items are in which list are shared.

options.label: Share photo and selection metadata
options.hint: When on, metadata on photos and selections is shared too, not only item metadata.

options.label: Debug logging
options.hint: Write detailed sync messages to Tropy's log files (Help > Show Log Files).
